question: Do the delivered Sakthi weights and code reproduce the stated BTC 15-minute historical predictions and trade metrics from independently reconstructed H4 inputs, and what changes under one-position accounting?
scope: Read-only source audit, frozen inference, native-target reconciliation, bounded causal/feature checks, and declared execution-policy sensitivity. No parameter search or H4a access.
population: 923007 valid minute origins, 2023-04-01 through 2024-12-31 UTC, inherited decision calendar
target: 10000 * (P(t+16min)/P(t+1min)-1); native H4 Y(t+1), VALID and no binding crossing
reported_threshold: absolute predicted signed score >= 10 bps; no outcome filter for all-trade performance
policy_sensitivity: Fixed threshold unchanged; first eligible signal when flat, one position for 15 minutes, both sides share the same position limit. Assumed round-trip costs 0,2,4,8 bps.
acceptance: Report hash, row, schema, target, inference and selection mismatches explicitly. Separate software/historical reproducibility from evidence of live profitability. Do not retune to recover the headline.
historical_exposure: All H4 evaluation periods have been used in iterative model research; none is a fresh holdout
protected_data: Neither Handoff 4a block is used for fitting or evaluation in this audit
user_steering: Multiple concurrent trades are permitted. The all-signal strategy remains primary; one-position accounting is a diagnostic comparison, not an acceptance requirement.
primary_position_policy: Take every eligible signal at declared equal per-entry notional; quantify simultaneous exposure, dependence and costs. No capital allocation is assumed to be authorized or optimal.
monthly_analysis: Primary all-entry strategy: each calendar month, including zero-entry months, with forecasts, long/short counts, wins/losses/breakeven, direction accuracy, >=10 bps hits, mean/sum gross bps and cost scenarios.
bounded_training_verification: After independent inputs are available, replay all seven frozen quarterly bundles and retrain only the latest 2024Q4 bundle with unchanged supplied settings. Record runtime-version differences; no search or H4a.
